name: stands_flat_floor
what: the whole fly in closed loop on the flat floor with no stimulus for 1 s; readout the thorax height and drift. The model lies down today (F-STAND-3 to 6), so this records where it ends up

harness.note: flyemu.organism.Organism with the body stepped and every sense reaching the brain, the loop of flyemu.run (observe, sense, network step, motor step); seeded default_rng(seed); noise per profile

readout.note: the c_thorax body's world-frame position (mm) sampled every 1 ms after the motor step: height median, minimum and last sample over the window, and the horizontal drift from first to last sample; also the run's NaN state and MuJoCo warning count

bar_todo: no bar yet: standing needs one number written down first, the thorax height (or body-floor clearance) that counts as standing, from a measured standing posture. Wang 2025's standing head height was spent as a setting (register), so it can't be the test. Proposed to the Director 21 Oct, not adopted
reference_script: python -m flyemu.run --tree . (defaults: m10f0, seed 12, flat floor, no stimulus) --ms 1000: the F-ZIP-1 tree run, spikes_sha256 770807852827186b and final_qpos_sha256 3ec293bad4b3b7b7 (runs/s22/fly2_zip/run_tree)
evidence_status: engineering seed 12 (register: F-ZIP-1 identity seeds); nothing is scored while there is no bar
